bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to game and fish; requiring a trumpeter swan study; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TRUMPETER SWAN STUDY; REPORT; APPROPRIATION.

$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of natural resources to study trumpeter swans in the state, including assessing the state's population and determining the feasibility of a trumpeter swan hunting season. By January l5, 2027, the commissioner must submit the results of the study and any policy recommendations to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over environment and natural resources policy and finance. This is a onetime appropriation.
